title: Tail latency jump past 500 ms SLA after deploy
what: Post-deploy p99 latency multiplier vs pre-deploy, or post-deploy p99 median (ms)

reader_questions.question: How much did p99 latency jump after deploy_v4.12.0?
reader_questions.expected: p99 jumped 2.88× from ~253 ms to ~729 ms (+476 ms), breaching the 500 ms SLA.

reader_questions.question: Was the p99 jump a one-minute blip or sustained?
reader_questions.expected: Sustained across all 30 post-deploy minutes (every post-deploy minute exceeds the 500 ms SLA).

reader_questions.question: Why did the release owner think the deploy looked harmless?
reader_questions.expected: Median (p50) latency barely moved (41.7 ms to 43.9 ms), masking the tail regression.
